Job Opportunity for Post-Doc

Fransina Stradling @f.stradling #1 2023-06-29 11:31 UTC

Sheffield Hallam Uni (UK) is recruiting (again) to a 32-month, full-time postdoc position to work on an AHRC-funded project “Reading Post Postmodern Fictions of the Digital” with Alice Bell and Jan Alber. More information here: https://bit.ly/Researchpostdoc. Closing: 2 July.
